articles.title: Sources: Seahawks to hire 49ers' Fleury as OC
articles.summary: The Seahawks are expected to hire 49ers tight ends coach Brian Fleury as their offensive coordinator, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Sunday.

articles.title: Sources: Raiders hire Seahawks' Janocko as OC
articles.summary: Seahawks QB coach Andrew Janocko has been hired as offensive coordinator for the Raiders, where he'll reunite with coach Klint Kubiak, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Carr: I'd unretire but only for chance to win SB
articles.summary: Derek Carr has confirmed he is willing to unretire but said it will take a special circumstance to lure him back to the playing field, which includes the chance to win a Super Bowl.

articles.title: NFL wins grievance regarding NFLPA report cards
articles.summary: The NFL won its grievance against the NFL Players Association, effectively banning the union from conducting and publishing future player report cards.

articles.title: Pats' Diggs pleads not guilty to assault allegation

articles.title: Ruling says Flores lawsuit vs. NFL can go to court
articles.summary: A U.S. district court ruled that Vikings defensive coordinator Brian Flores' ongoing discrimination case against the NFL can proceed in open court.

articles.title: Bills' Brady adds Fox to staff as senior assistant
articles.summary: New Bills coach Joe Brady has added NFL head coaching experience to his staff, hiring John Fox as a senior assistant coach. The Bills announced Fox and more of the team's coaching staff, which now includes 20 assistants, on Friday.
